title: iPhone 16 Plus Drops Rs 9,901 on Flipkart to Rs 79,999
excerpt: Flipkart has cut the iPhone 16 Plus 128GB from its Rs 89,900 launch price to Rs 79,999, with the same Rs 9,901 off all storage variants, a further 5% Flipkart Axis Bank discount, and up to Rs 60,200 in exchange value.
body:
• The iPhone 16 Plus (128GB) is listed on Flipkart at Rs 79,999, down Rs 9,901 from its Rs 89,900 launch price, according to Digit and the Free Press Journal.
  • The same Rs 9,901 cut applies to all three storage variants — 128GB, 256GB and 512GB — on Flipkart.
  • Paying with a Flipkart Axis Bank card takes a further 5% off, and EMI starts at Rs 2,813 per month with no-cost EMI options; exchange of an old phone can add up to Rs 60,200 in value, depending on model and condition.
  • Amazon is higher for the same phone: Rs 82,500 for the Ultramarine colour and Rs 83,500 for other colours, against the same Rs 89,900 launch price.

Apple's iPhone 16 Plus has become cheaper in India, with Flipkart listing the 128GB model at Rs 79,999 — a flat Rs 9,901 cut from its Rs 89,900 launch price. The discount applies across the range, and bank and exchange offers can push the effective price lower still, according to Digit.

How the Flipkart deal breaks down

The headline cut is Rs 9,901 on the listed price, from Rs 89,900 to Rs 79,999 for the 128GB model. The Free Press Journal reports that all three storage variants — 128GB, 256GB and 512GB — carry the same Rs 9,901 discount on Flipkart. On top of the listed price, buyers using a Flipkart Axis Bank card get a further 5% discount, which takes the total saving past Rs 10,000. EMI options start at Rs 2,813 per month, including no-cost EMI, and trading in an old smartphone can add up to Rs 60,200 in exchange value, depending on the model's working condition and variant, Digit reported. The phone is sold in Black, White, Pink, Teal and Ultramarine.

Flipkart vs Amazon

Flipkart is the cheaper of the two big marketplaces for this model. On Amazon, the iPhone 16 Plus is listed at Rs 82,500 for the Ultramarine variant — a Rs 7,400 discount — and Rs 83,500 for the other colours, against the same Rs 89,900 launch price, according to the Free Press Journal. That is a gap of Rs 2,501 to Rs 3,501 in Flipkart's favour before bank offers are counted on either platform.

What you get for Rs 79,999

The iPhone 16 Plus has a 6.7-inch Super Retina XDR OLED display with a 60Hz refresh rate and peak brightness of 2,000 nits. It runs on Apple's A18 chipset with Apple Intelligence features, and Apple claims up to 27 hours of video playback. The dual camera system pairs a 48MP main camera with a 12MP ultrawide lens, with a 12MP front camera, and the phone adds the Camera Control button with Visual Intelligence. The handset is IP68 dust and water resistant. For buyers who wanted the larger screen and battery of the Plus model but not its launch price, the Rs 79,999 listing — before the 5% bank discount and any exchange value — is the lowest headline price reported for the phone on Flipkart.
